item.title: FRCN pensioners to join nationwide naked protest over unpaid entitlements
item.description: Pensioners of the Federal Radio Corporation of Nigeria, FRCN, have declared their readiness to join a nationwide naked protest slated for December 8 to demand the payment of long-overdue entitlements. The National Financial Secretary of the FRCN pensioners, Bola Popoola, made this known in a statement issued on Saturday in Lagos. item.title: Lagos: Two Epe community leaders docked over alleged vandalism, theft of Lanre Razak’s property
item.description: Two members of the Epe community, 63-year-old Musbau Oloruntoyin Amsdau and 45-year-old Fuad Adebayo Amuni, have been arrested and brought before a magistrates’ court for allegedly vandalising and stealing assets belonging to the late Lagos political figure, Lanre Razak. item.title: 23 dead in suspected gas explosion at Goa nightclub
item.description: At least 23 people have lost their lives following a fire at a nightclub in Goa, India, according to local authorities and media reports on Sunday. Most of the victims are believed to have been employees of the club, with their bodies recovered from the premises, Indian Express and other outlets reported. item.title: Fear spreads in Benue communities over influx of herders
item.description: Fear has gripped residents of Tombo Ward in Logo Local Government Area of Benue State following the influx of large numbers of herders grazing their cattle without permission in the community. The fear in the community is compounded over allegations that the herders are heavily armed with sophisticated weapons which they display openly.
